label: Website Screenshot API
title: Website Screenshot API: Full-Page & Custom Viewports
metaDescription: Capture high-quality screenshots of any website with full-page support, custom viewports, cookie sign-in and smart load detection.
intro: Give it website URLs and get high-quality screenshots, full page or at a custom viewport, with cookie sign-in and smart detection of when the page has finished loading.
useCases: Add page screenshots to reports and docs
